run_gigahand_processing: run the gigahand dataset processor to convert hand and object pose data to npz format
extract_hand_data: extract wrist pose and fingertip positions from MANO hand model parameters for a given hand
load_model: load SMPL, SMPLH, SMPLX, or MANO body models with configurable gender and skeleton type
interpolate_object_poses: interpolate and smooth object translation and rotation poses across missing frames using Slerp
compute_mesh_centroid: compute the centroid of a 3D mesh vertices using pymeshlab for centering
